verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring automated operations, such as recurring payments or filings, is a fair question for an online tax-services platform, so the axis applies. The pack lists only the titles of EFTPS and Payment Plan pages, with no documented ability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The MeF/IRIS machine channels are one-off transmission rails with no scheduling evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
